stepExplanation: By day 5-6 after fertilization, the dividing cells form a hollow ball called a blastocyst. The blastocyst consists of an outer layer (trophoblast) that will form the placenta and an inner cell mass that will become the embryo.
stepBody: What is the name of the hollow ball of cells that implants in the uterine wall approximately 6-7 days after fertilization?
